title: Job-housing balance and job burnout among migrant workers: mechanisms and implications for housing support policies
core_idea: Investigate how the placement of affordable housing that achieves a job-housing balance influences job burnout among migrant workers, using 2018 China Labour Force Dynamic Survey data and 2023 in-depth interviews, and examine mechanisms including labour intensity, work quality, and dormitory-type arrangements to inform housing support siting.
tldr: Assess the effects and mechanisms by which job-housing-balanced affordable housing locations relate to migrant worker job burnout, combining national survey data and qualitative interviews to guide housing support policy and siting decisions.
